description: Pointer index (SUE-1426 R4): which EXISTING real-output-corpus entries the owner has approved as comparison examples for which voice family / target. Locators and entry ids only; no corpus text is copied here. An entry counts only if the corpus entry itself is owner_verdict=accepted AND reference_eligible=true AND is not a synthetic placeholder. Nothing is invented: an empty list means NO_APPROVED_REFERENCE for that target.
